metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in Taipei,Taiwan decrease in January 17-24, 2016 compared to the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Taipei, Taiwan (~25.03°N, 121.56°E) - Time periods: * Reference: January 17-24 for years 2001-2010 (10-year average) * Comparison: January 17-24, 2016 - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A1 or MOD11A2) for consistent long-term data 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has QA bands to filter poor quality pixels - Cloud masking using QA flags - This is about temperature comparison, not clouds, so mask clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixel count is 0 after masking (C2) - Valid LST range: typically -40°C to 60°C (233K to 333K in Kelvin) - If result is None/NaN or outside reasonable range → C3 - Compare 2016 mean vs 2001-2010 mean: if 2016 < baseline → A (Yes, decreased), else → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const taipei = ee.Geometry.Point([121.56, 25.03]); const region = taipei.buffer(10000); // 10km radius around Taipei // 2. Data Acquisition // MODIS LST Day (MOD11A1) - daily 1km resolution const lstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .select('LST_Day_1km'); // Quality masking function function maskLowQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('QC_Day'); // Keep only pixels with good quality (bits 0-1 = 00) const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Baseline period: Jan 17-24, 2001-2010 let baselineImages = []; for (let year = 2001; year <= 2010; year++) { const yearCol = lstCollection .filterBounds(taipei) .filterDate(`${year}-01-17`, `${year}-01-25`) .map(maskLowQuality); baselineImages.push(yearCol); } const baselineCol = ee.ImageCollection(baselineImages.flat()); // 2016 period: Jan 17-24 const col2016 = lstCollection .filterBounds(taipei) .filterDate('2016-01-17', '2016-01-25') .map(maskLowQuality); const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); const size2016 = col2016.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline (2001-2010) images: ${baselineSize}`); console.log(`2016 images: ${size2016}`); if (baselineSize === 0 || size2016 === 0) { console.log("Insufficient data for comparison."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate mean LST for each period const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean(); const mean2016 = col2016.mean(); // 4. Reduce to get statistics const baselineStats = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2016 = mean2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const baselineLST = baselineStats['LST_Day_1km_mean']; const baselineCount = baselineStats['LST_Day_1km_count']; const lst2016 = stats2016['LST_Day_1km_mean']; const count2016 = stats2016['LST_Day_1km_count']; console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baselineCount}`); console.log(`2016 valid pixels: ${count2016}`); if (!baselineCount || baselineCount === 0 || !count2016 || count2016 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Convert from Kelvin scale factor (0.02) to Celsius const baselineTempC = (baselineLST * 0.02) - 273.15; const temp2016C = (lst2016 * 0.02) - 273.15; console.log(`Baseline LST (2001-2010): ${baselineTempC.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`2016 LST: ${temp2016C.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (baselineLST == null || lst2016 == null || isNaN(baselineTempC) || isNaN(temp2016C) || baselineTempC < -40 || baselineTempC > 60 || temp2016C < -40 || temp2016C > 60) { console.log("Invalid temperature calculation."); console.log("C3"); return; } const difference = temp2016C - baselineTempC; console.log(`Temperature difference: ${difference.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (temp2016C < baselineTempC) { console.log("2016 LST decreased compared to baseline."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("2016 LST did not decrease compared to baseline."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
